description: Ten days before the election, the conversations that matter most happen on front porches. Join Rebecca MacTaggart and fellow volunteers at Pavilion #1 in Palmer Park. There you can get your walk list and spend the afternoon talking with Donora neighbors about what's at stake for House District 48.
paid_for_by: Paid for by Rebecca MacTaggart for PA
title: Canvassing Drive in Donora — Rebecca MacTaggart for PA
